scope: Actual publisher-native standalone d3-lite CPU replay of exactly two previously exposed public initial-state requests. Full original/native payloads and raw/normalized responses are preserved below. No browser rollout or training.
call_accounting_limit: Pre-invocation native_call_attempts count durable entry intent, not proved forwards. Saved raw responses establish publisher call return, not an independently traced backbone forward. Missing or interrupted records never imply zero actual calls.

native_policy.all_heads: All original ordered questions/candidates, including inactive targets and singleton heads; no pruning, hierarchy, operation-first, or target repairs.
native_policy.confidence_semantics: Raw native confidence is normalized entropy confidence. Normalized confidence is the chosen probability, with pmax margin. Both full responses remain below.

controller_error.message: mandatory CPU request failed or exceeded budget; all actual responses retained

process_result.budget_policy: One cooperative20s timer per full request covers parse/preflight/checkpoints/native call. Late raw output, normalization, selection and CPU/wall costs are retained before failure; no hard cancellation. Standalone replay uses no HTTP transport.

known_cpu_validation_overlap.evidence_type: Post-hoc preservation of observed tool transcript; not an original redirected stdout file
known_cpu_validation_overlap.unintended_selection: -k owned_loader also matched semantic-corruption parameter wrong_owned_loader, creating the cached-tokenizer fake-native-Agent synthetic24 fixture
known_cpu_validation_overlap.limitation: Root reported this unintended CPU-validation overlap during the lite worker. The preserved post-hoc observed tool transcript is not an original redirected stdout log. Tool-yield durations do not bound full process lifetime. Raw114.456s/22.794s observations are retained but are not clean inter-model latency comparisons and establish no GPU failure. No rerun hides or replaces them.

provisioning.body_byte_limit: response.read bytes including retained failed partials; not network wire traffic
provisioning.scope: Reviewed credential-free public HF HTTPS source policy plus saved stream/redirect-host/byte/hash receipts; not an independent HTTP/socket trace.

resource_admission.limitation: Declared additive floor with live same-boot MemAvailable observations, not a measured peak or OOM guarantee; no shared-memory or swap credit.

replay.input_authentication_scope: each named input authenticated at read time; no stable-at-exit claim

six_fixed_family_checkpoint_identities.name: d3-edge
six_fixed_family_checkpoint_identities.execution_status: CPU synthetic and two-state evidence exists, CUDA/browser still pending

family_execution_status_at_this_record.d3-lite: this two-initial-request CPU-only run; both late; no browser or CUDA evaluation
family_execution_status_at_this_record.d3-edge: separate previously recorded CPU synthetic and two-initial-request evidence; no new execution in this lite run

saved_native_provenance.policy: One forward pass per question; options under single-token answer codes; last-token readout over the question's codes only; argmax choice; no truncation (over-limit questions are refused); no option filtering; one fixed prompt for every request.

images.placement: before the text of the user turn, one placeholder per image, request order
images.patch_embedding: matrix product (equal to the Conv3d with kernel = stride)

videos.placement: after the images, before the text of the user turn, one placeholder per video, request order; every two frames are one token group after their timestamp
videos.sampling: source frames spread evenly over the whole video (frame arrays: frames at 2 per second)

evidence_limits: Saved unique gate files/ledger match all source-declared stages; no independent process or syscall hook traced the worker.
Two durable entry intents and two public system_one returns/seven native rows are source-controlled and supported by saved responses; no independent forward hook trace or logits replay.
CPU/BF16/F32/T1/thread2/no CUDA initialization are source guards and saved provenance; CUDA13.0 is build metadata, not evidence of GPU execution. No independent GPU utilization/syscall trace.
Current CPU tokenizers0.23.3 and cached tokenizer independently reproduce all saved IDs. Its current extension is pinned now; actual worker shared-library execution was not traced.
Independent prompt reconstruction covers these seven text-only native prompts; no image/video behavior was tested.
No browser actions, rollout, task completion/accuracy, held-out generalization, CUDA provider parity, CPU/GPU numerical or speed superiority is established.
Provisioning facts are crosschecks of reviewed source, saved byte/hash receipts, terminal cache authentication and unique gate journals; no independent socket or process trace.
Public byte counts are response.read body bytes, including any recorded partials, not network wire traffic; redirect hosts are retained, not raw HTTP response transcripts.
The separate replay audit independently streamed both final checkpoint files after fresh live gates. This supplement reads no tensor payload.
The known CPU-validation overlap has unmeasured timing impact. This record cannot support clean CPU inter-model latency comparisons, GPU behavior/failure, or CPU/GPU parity.
The native source declares one forward per question; seven returned question rows do not constitute an independently traced backbone-forward count.
Exactly two previously exposed saved initial states were replayed. No fresh task, seed, website, browser execution, action result, task score, model win, training, or promotion is claimed.

The original prospective family inventory remains verbatim and labels lite unlaunched as of planning. The separate actual status map records this completed CPU-only lite run without rewriting that historical plan.
